title: Warm Spiced Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A savory and molten Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb in a rich sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and low-carb-friendly when served without traditional couscous.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces in batches until they are nicely browned on all sides.
Remove the browned lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, browned lamb, and chopped dried apricots to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the broken dark chocolate until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Serve the tagine hot, wrapped in corn husks if desired.
